title: Signet-compatible signer path for Loom canonical projections
intent: Bahia Loom canonical projection must not require raw private key signing in the projection core. It should accept a signer interface compatible with the existing Signet/NIP-46 client while preserving explicit raw-key compatibility for development and migration callers.
observed_behavior_before: ProjectCanonicalStatus, ProjectCanonicalResult, and ProjectCanonicalJobState accepted only a raw private key string and directly called nostrutil.SignEventWithHexKey for both 30900 state and 4903 audit events.
intended_behavior: Projection signing goes through CanonicalSigner.Sign(ctx, event). Existing Signet client shape satisfies this interface. Raw private key signing is isolated behind HexKeyCanonicalSigner compatibility wrappers. Missing or failing signers fail explicitly before publish.
out_of_scope: Rewiring every production caller to inject Signet client configuration
Changing Loom event kinds or relay publish semantics
Removing raw-key compatibility wrappers before all callers migrate
